source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Much-branched deciduous shrub or small tree to ~4 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate simple reticulate-veined, roundish to broadly ovate blades up to 10 × 10 cm, slightly lobed or angled, basal base truncate to weakly heart-shaped
morphology_documented.flowers: Drooping axillary 3–5-flowered racemes, often appearing terminal; white united-at-base petals 12–15 × 4–6 mm, ten stamens
morphology_documented.fruit: Round capsule ~7–8 mm with three apical valves, generally one seed

source_scope_note: Historic taxonomic rank maintained; comparative key traits or family-only descriptions not automatically promoted to accepted species level.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Regional account records Bell and Burnet counties, but does not establish BONAP Hays county native status
preservation: Additive species source references only; no original records, photos, credits or galleries changed
